verdict: Paid sales are accelerating; several planned deliverables are overdue.
narrative: This period your Meta ads returned $4.95 for every $1 spent — and that momentum is building, with purchases up 40% and return on ad spend up 18.73% week-over-week. The recent session spike on October 24–25 (375 and 575 visits on those days versus a 28-day daily average of roughly 249) appears to be driven by organic Instagram reach rather than additional paid spend, which is an encouraging sign. On the local side, Google Business Profile actions dropped 36% in the last seven days, with the final two days showing no recorded actions — we're looking into what's behind that and will have an update shortly. Separately, several planned milestones — including automation flows, subscribe pages, and the first monthly report — are past their target dates, and resolving those is the immediate priority heading into November.
